tasks.name: 已派出卡
tasks.test: pa_check_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pa-node-check.XXXXXX")" && trap 'rm -rf "$pa_check_dir"' EXIT && git archive --format=tar --output="$pa_check_dir/source.tar" HEAD && tar -xf "$pa_check_dir/source.tar" -C "$pa_check_dir" && /bin/cp -R code/agent/node_modules "$pa_check_dir/code/agent/node_modules" && cd "$pa_check_dir/code/agent" && npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/dispatch-card.test.js dist/test/worker.test.js dist/test/reliability.test.js
